lane: units (fighters, monsters and Wicks in game)

items.evidence: Committed in HEAD (applied after color_fragment for valeCharMode > 1.5, i.e. fighters only; uniform branch, no define). I re-captured at a new seed and time (max_units_ab --tag v2u --variants base,mat --seed 11 --t 480, current prod build) and read the crops at full resolution. Dunsom reads lilac, Marund peach, Rishal a cooler blue, Burdam warmer, and Vashil's hood is bluer. My measure over the changed pixels, mean RGB saturation base -> mat: Burdam 14.2->21.0, Dunsom 10.7->19.1, Ervet 7.9->13.1, Kemdo 21.9->27.9, Marund 9.8->17.4, Odrum 13.3->19.4, Rishal 10.5->17.8, Tunlan 18.8->28.6, Vashil 10.1->16.5. Crop mean diff is 0.67-3.92, which matches the claim (1.1-3.6). The engineer's sheets u1fix_gamecam_ab.png and u1fix_12m_ab.png show the same. Value gates (fighterBlowout 0.40/0.04 %, top-25 81) are as claimed and I did not re-run them. This is a real gain you can see. It is a global chroma lift, though, not the plan's material zoning: Kemdo, Burdam, Vashil and Tunlan are still mostly cream or beige figures, and Rishal's crimson still does not reach the body.

I re-ran max_units_life.mjs on the current build and it reproduces the claim exactly: Vashil idle 319->0 and channel 319->24, Burdam recall 128->21, Ervet recall 114->70, Odrum idle 24->31 and recall 76->60, Kemdo idle 319->0. I also covered the fighters the claim left out, with --picks lisvel,ulkro,sukri,ardit,ilsheta,nurrow,hesmi: Lisvel idle 319->4 and channel 319->40, Ulkro idle 319->0, Ardit idle 319->0, Ilsheta recall 44->20. Every idle hold is now 14 frames or less. The longest hold left is Ervet recall at 70 frames (1.2 s of a 7 s channel).

u1fix_hue.json records value_probe --monsters at t 400: unitPx 53,291 against the 51,944 gate, so it passes. I did not re-run it, because the claim matches verify1's 1.4 measurement of 51,671 scaled by 1.42^2/1.4^2.
glb_zero_metal.py --check passes on all 48 fighter GLBs, and content:check (which includes the checkZeroMetal gate) has 0 warnings.
Unchanged since verify1. I saw no regression in the life runs.
